verdictRationale: The Stage-C obligation audit is clean: adr 2 is discharged by docs/adr/2026-08-03-optimistic-concurrency-on-task-updates.md (no READY was possible without it), openspec 1's delta spec exists and validates --strict, verify 1's data-store safeguard checks (the surface both fired triggers cite) all pass, no checkpoint reported newStops, and the dimension vector never decreased across K1-K4 so no human override was needed. Build and tests were re-run independently: 0/0 and 11/11. One named residual (VFY-003) - C-003's atomicity is code-evidenced rather than test-evidenced - is a recorded coverage-honesty limitation, not an unmet obligation, so it caps nothing.
commentary: verify ran because the classified verify dimension is 1, attributed to TRG-001 (M2 sensitive-surface) and TRG-002 (M1 posture-crossing), both on the data-store surface. That attribution selected the safeguard set: persistence/store-semantics checks (version monotonicity, conflict-path immutability, seeding, compare-and-swap atomicity, boundary integrity), not auth or migration checks. review stayed at 0 - X2 did not fire at K4 because the inline self-review was clean - so no standalone review pass was owed.

findings.title: adr 2 obligation discharged before READY
findings.detail: TRG-002 (M1 posture-crossing, adjudication, surface data-store) raised adr to 2, which blocks a READY verdict until an ADR exists. docs/adr/2026-08-03-optimistic-concurrency-on-task-updates.md records the accepted crossing, its options, and its consequences, and cites PROP-DEC-001.

findings.title: openspec 1 obligation satisfied at the classified depth
findings.detail: TRG-002 (M1) put openspec at 1. openspec/changes/optimistic-concurrency-updates/specs/task-api/spec.md exists and validates --strict. No proposal.md/design.md/tasks.md were written, correctly: the C-13 distinct-surface rule does not raise the full set because TRG-001 and TRG-002 both cite data-store. Consequence recorded rather than smoothed over: `openspec status --change ... --json` returns isComplete false, because the CLI measures the full artifact set and has no notion of a classified depth. The obligation owed by the classifier is met; the CLI's completeness flag is not the obligation.

findings.title: C-003 (atomic compare-and-swap) is code-evidenced, not test-evidenced
findings.detail: Safeguard check for the data-store surface cited by TRG-001 (M2) and TRG-002 (M1). Inspection confirms TaskStore.Update performs the version comparison and the write inside one ConcurrentDictionary.TryUpdate and retries on a lost race, with no check-then-act in the endpoint. The WebApplicationFactory harness cannot deterministically schedule the interleaving that would distinguish an atomic CAS from a racy one, so no test asserts it directly; the deliver record carries the whyNotTest.
findings.recommendation: If this store ever gains a second writer path or moves off ConcurrentDictionary, add a store-level concurrency test (parallel Update calls asserting exactly one winner per version) rather than relying on inspection.

findings.title: data-store safeguard checks pass: version monotonicity, conflict immutability, seeding
findings.detail: Trigger-attributed checks for the data-store surface (TRG-001 M2, TRG-002 M1): (a) every successful PUT increments version by exactly 1, proven across two consecutive updates (1->2->3); (b) a rejected 409 leaves title, status, priority and version all unchanged, asserted field-by-field after the conflict; (c) seeded and newly created tasks start at version 1; (d) the crossing did not leak the HTTP layer into the domain (R-004 still passes).

findings.title: Stops and monotonicity audit clean
findings.detail: K1 reported newStops 0 (the M1/M2 questions folded into the mandatory FRAME approval stop, per design law 2); K2, K3 and K4 each reported newStops 0 and no stopSatisfiedBy claim was made. The dimension vector was stops 1 / evidence.targeted 1 / evidence.breadth 0 / review 0 / verify 1 / openspec 1 / adr 2 from the K1 merge call onward and never decreased, so no human-override record was required.
